Effective Field Goal Percentage

Source: R/nba_metrics.R
nba_effective_fg_pct.Rd

Field-goal percentage adjusted for the extra value of the three-pointer: (FGM + 0.5 * FG3M) / FGA.

Usage

nba_effective_fg_pct(fgm, fg3m, fga)

Arguments

fgm, fg3m, fga

Numeric vectors: field goals made, three-pointers made, field-goal attempts.

Value

A numeric vector of effective field-goal percentages (0-1 scale).

See also

Other Basketball Analytics Utilities: nba_add_advanced_metrics(), nba_assist_pct(), nba_assist_to_turnover(), nba_defensive_rating(), nba_four_factors(), nba_ft_rate(), nba_game_score(), nba_net_rating(), nba_offensive_rating(), nba_oreb_pct(), nba_pace(), nba_per_minutes(), nba_per_possessions(), nba_possessions(), nba_true_shooting_pct(), nba_turnover_pct(), nba_usage_rate()

Examples

nba_effective_fg_pct(fgm = 10, fg3m = 4, fga = 20)
#> [1] 0.6
